defmodule Robot do
  @moduledoc "A robot."
  defstruct pos: {0, 0}, dir: :north

  @type t :: %__MODULE__{pos: {integer, integer}, dir: atom}

  @spec move(t, String.t()) :: {:ok, t} | {:error, term}
  def move(%__MODULE__{} = r, cmds) when is_binary(cmds) do
    cmds
    |> String.graphemes()
    |> Enum.reduce_while({:ok, r}, fn
      "A", {:ok, %{pos: {x, y}} = r} -> {:cont, {:ok, %{r | pos: {x, y + 1}}}}
      c, _ -> {:halt, {:error, c}}
    end)
  end

  defmacro unless_nil(x, do: block), do: quote(do: if(unquote(x) != nil, do: unquote(block)))
end
